static_traits.name: Li Man
static_traits.social_status: Has a few friends in Sweden, but has not yet discussed forgetfulness with them
static_traits.medical_history: No major physical illness; without similar prior problems or psychotherapy history
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression, good logic, steady speech rate, able to give concrete examples, Positive attitude, high cooperation, with some Anxiety

basic_info.main_problem: I often feel that I am losing things, and recently forgetfulness and disorganization problems have appeared in daily life. This problem began to appear a few months ago after moving to Sweden, and has now developed into frequently misplacing important items and forgetting tasks, occurring every day when under high pressure or busy.
basic_info.core_demands: I decided to seek counseling because forgetfulness and lack of organization started affecting my daily functioning and Interpersonal relationships.
growth_experiences: Moved to Sweden several months ago, feeling overwhelmed by the cross-country move (initial stress was moderate). Gradually developed forgetfulness and disorganization after the move: often losing items, forgetting tasks, missing appointments, problems more frequent in busy and high-pressure situations. No similar problems or psychotherapy history before, without major physical illness. Work performance affected after the move, relationships with friends and colleagues set back, daily life more chaotic and Increased stress; although having a few friends in Sweden to talk about daily life, has not yet talked to them about forgetfulness.

core_beliefs: I am a disorganized person who makes mistakes easily
If not well organized, will be seen as unreliable

special_situations.event: During busy and high-pressure periods at work or in life, needing to handle multiple tasks simultaneously
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: I must put everything back in place immediately, strictly follow rules, otherwise mistakes will happen and prove me unreliable
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Repeatedly reminding oneself 'should put things back in place', trying to set fixed spots and use reminders, but execution is unstable
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: If I do not put it back this time, I will definitely lose it again

special_situations.event: Facing important tasks and deadlines at work
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I forget a task even once, others will think I am unprofessional and unreliable
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Excessive worry, shouldering problems alone without seeking colleague or friend support, increasing Self-monitoring
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Colleagues will think I am unreliable

special_situations.event: Finding oneself unable to find keys or important items before going out or near appointments
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Losing something once means I will always lose things
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Repeatedly checks and delays going out to reduce mistakes

special_situations.event: Adaptation pressure from the new environment and new systems after moving to Sweden
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: I must adapt completely right away and stay perfectly organized, otherwise life and work will collapse
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Forces oneself to quickly establish a whole set of rules and habits, but finds them hard to maintain due to excessive load
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: If I do not adapt well, my life and Work will be a mess

core_conflict.wish: Longing to stay in control and organized, seen as reliable by others and Gaining recognition
core_conflict.fear: Worrying about being judged unreliable and thus blamed, rejected or losing opportunities
defense_goal: Lowering Anxiety by internalizing strict rules and strengthening self-control
Avoiding seeking help to prevent exposing one's 'unreliability'
Focusing on solutions in a rationalized way while avoiding shame and helplessness

object_relations.self_representation: An individual prone to mistakes, needing constant self-restraint
object_relations.object_representation: Others who constantly judge and question reliability

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When asked about emotional impact or interpersonal damage details
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Feeling one will be judged as an unreliable person (transference: seeing others as critical judges)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Gentle and steady tone, first empathizing with their stress and shame, then softly probing specific feelings with open-ended questions; slowing down, allowing pauses, avoiding quick advice that might intensify their self-criticism.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When many self-demands of 'I should/must...' appear
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Believing only strict compliance with inner rules can avoid being negated (transference: internalizing external standards as inner judgment)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Inviting awareness of the source of 'should' in an accepting tone, distinguishing external standards from self needs; using gentle restatement and normalization, encouraging replacing 'I should' with 'I need/I choose'.

manifestations: High adaptation pressure after relocating to Sweden
Having only a few friends, and not yet discussing forgetfulness with them
In high-pressure and busy situations, tends to bear things alone
outcomes: Chaotic daily life and rising pressure

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'.
manifestations: Frequently using self-instructions like 'I should put things back in place'
Treats perfect order as a standard that must be achieved

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: Excessive self-criticism, worrying about being seen as unreliable
Tending to cope alone rather than seeking friends' help
Raises self-demands further under high pressure

positive_force: Positive attitude, willing to seek help and participate in problem-solving training
Able to describe problem situations concretely and propose feasible steps (setting fixed spots, using reminders, schedule reviews)
Has some social support (several friends in Sweden)
Open to building habits and consistency
negative_force: Cross-border relocation causes adaptation stress and environmental change
Excessive executive-function load in busy and high-pressure times, worsening forgetfulness and disorder
Self-reproach and perfection demands centered on 'should'
Avoiding help-seeking, tending to shoulder alone, insufficient resource mobilization
Lacks stable consistency in execution and situational strategies

target_behavior.behavior: Forgetfulness and disorganization (often misplacing items, forgetting tasks, being late)
antecedent: New environment and institutional changes after moving to Sweden
As deadlines or appointment times approach
Lacks fixed spots and consistent habits
target_behavior.core_reason: Changes of environment and role bring pressure to adapt, leading to scattered attention and a rise in executive-function load; internal 'should' rules increase self-pressure, and instead weaken the formation and maintenance of stable habits
target_behavior.function: Passively reducing current cognitive load and discomfort under pressure (escaping high-load tasks/decision pressure), but not intentionally
target_behavior.consequence: Work performance affected,Interpersonal tension,Chaotic daily life and rising pressure
